items.title: India to host the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi
items.text: India is scheduled to host the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting on 13 October in New Delhi. The meeting is intended to strengthen regional cooperation on security among member countries.

items.title: Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand begins a visit to India
items.text: Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand is scheduled to visit India and the United Arab Emirates from 13 to 16 October, with bilateral relations and cooperation among the key areas of engagement.

items.title: Indian government bond yields rise after RBI liquidity and currency measures
items.text: Business reporting on 13 October says government bond yields reached a roughly three-and-a-half-year high after recent Reserve Bank of India measures. The movement reflects the effect of liquidity and currency-market policy on borrowing costs.

items.title: Markets watch a possible positive opening as crude oil remains above $106
items.text: The 13 October market briefing reported GIFT Nifty pointing to a positive start for Indian equities, while crude oil prices above $106 and elevated global bond yields remained risks for investors.

items.title: Abhishek Sharma's 69 off 30 balls powers India's total against West Indies
items.text: In the third T20I, Abhishek Sharma scored 69 from 30 balls as India posted 223. West Indies finished on 209/7, falling 14 runs short in the chase.

items.title: Kumar Kushagra replaces injured Rishabh Pant for the first two India A matches
items.text: Rishabh Pant has been ruled out of the first two India A matches against New Zealand A after sustaining a side strain. Kumar Kushagra has been named as his replacement for those matches.

items.title: International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction is observed on 13 October
items.text: The annual observance highlights disaster preparedness, risk awareness and measures that help communities reduce the impact of natural and human-made hazards.
